description:
Functional specifications covered with associated files to edit/add: lib/zaq/engine/connect/credential.ex, grant.ex, connect.ex changeset entry points, priv/repo/migrations/*, test/zaq/engine/connect/* schema/migration tests. Read moduledocs before edits. Add personal_credential_policy Ecto.Enum disabled/optional/required with database default disabled, NOT NULL and CHECK. Keep user_level unrelated. SUPERSEDING USER-APPROVED REVISION: remove binding_type and person_id completely from the uncommitted migration, schema, changesets and tests. Reuse owner_type/owner_id with person and resource_type/resource_id with connect_credential. Derive canonical resource_type and resource_id server-side; NULL-safe CHECK enforces resource_id = credential_id::text and existing credential_id FK verifies target. Non-null person owner_id is checked against a literal current active Person at the trusted storage boundary; this is not caller authentication and does not coordinate concurrent deletion. No Person FK, triggers or guard rows. Canonical person unique index uses credential_id/owner_id across statuses. Canonical org owner_id must be NULL. Partial unique indexes enforce one canonical person grant per credential/person and one canonical org grant per credential, regardless of status. Retain revoked/expired row; reconnection replaces current row. Reject ambiguous canonical user ownership until separately specified; existing user resource grants remain supported. Grant provider/auth_kind/request_format and scopes derive from credential, not client attrs. Determine the smallest explicit canonical credential mode necessary to allow JWT credentials without configuration-level private keys while retaining legacy JWT validation; document that distinction rather than overloading user_level or policy.

Tests to add before implementation: migration on representative existing rows; unchanged legacy issue/list/resolve behavior; policy default/invalid enum; current Person checks for missing/inactive/deleted/merged-alias identity on creation/update; accepted deletion-between-check-and-insert orphan behavior with independent connections; NULL global uniqueness; concurrent inserts using independent committed connections; revoked/expired rows still occupy slot; canonical resource equality and NULL bypass rejection, server-derived coordinates, and unchanged legacy resource pairs; authentication fields cannot disagree with configuration; required JWT can store grant-owned key material.

Branches/paths validated: all three auth kinds; org/user legacy; person canonical; absent Person; deleted credential; duplicate statuses; migration retry and rollback constraints with personal data present. Refuse destructive down migration while canonical grants exist rather than silently losing secrets.

Mocking plan: none; real Ecto/PostgreSQL and encryption storage. Race tests use isolated data and explicit cleanup, not shared global sandbox mutation. Dependencies: Repo, migration runner and encryption config existing seams.

Documentations to update for both code and docs/: schema moduledocs/types; docs/services/engine.md storage ownership and compatibility; docs/services/system-config.md distinction between configuration and grant secrets. Done: additive migration, tested rollback policy, no AI/schema consumer changes, no provider-wide uniqueness, >=95% changed application-file coverage.

2026-09-14 FINAL USER-APPROVED STORAGE DECISION: canonical grants reuse owner_type/owner_id (org with NULL ID or person with non-null ID) and resource_type=connect_credential/resource_id=credential_id string. Native type/shape and explicit non-null/equality CHECKs plus existing credential_id FK; partial unique org/person slots across statuses. No binding_type, duplicate person_id, extra Person FK, triggers or guard rows. Server derives resource pair and configuration auth fields; secret_binding stays independent. Trusted canonical storage checks literal current active Person, without authenticating callers or resolving aliases. Concurrent orphan grants/secrets are an accepted residual risk. IDs must not be reused operationally; no silent reidentification through stale aliases; synchronous erasure is not guaranteed. Later resolver must check Person exists/eligible BEFORE policy selection even disabled, and missing/stale Person errors NEVER fall back globally. Authenticated writes and OAuth/refresh must recheck current identity; lifecycle cleanup/reconciliation and later distributed server invalidation remain unimplemented in storage task .1.

comments.text: Implemented storage-only schema/migration and encrypted change_credential_grant/3 entry point; no canonical mutation API, resolver, AI or Person management changes. Decisions: explicit secret_binding enum defaults configuration; grant mode relaxes only configuration JWT private_key requirement, retaining issuer/key_id/profile/subject checks. Canonical grant auth fields/scopes derive from trusted Credential and secrets never copy from configuration. Legacy listing/resolution/scheduled refresh filter resource lane. Person FK restricts deletion pending zaq-jrg.8. Rollback locks tables and refuses canonical grants or nondefault config. Initial TDD run: 9 expected failures; DB upgrade/down/up, constraints and independent committed race tests implemented. Rollback test moved to committed fixtures because SQL Sandbox auto-rolls back on DDL error; real Migrator test now passes with migration_lock:false (avoids sandbox single-connection lock checkout deadlock). Validation and coverage in progress; issue stays in progress.

Validation complete for working-tree implementation: final mix format and mix q exit 0; Credo checks 1181 source files with no issues. Final focused MIX_ENV=test mix coveralls.json test/zaq/engine/connect test/zaq/engine/connect_test.exs test/zaq/engine/connect_token_edge_cases_test.exs test/zaq/engine/connect_encryption_error_test.exs exit 0: 129 tests + 1 property, 0 failures. Changed application-file coverage: Connect 95.3% (184/193 relevant lines), Credential 100% (20/20), Grant 100% (24/24). Real PostgreSQL validation includes legacy upgrade/down/up and migration retry, DB defaults/CHECKs/FKs, org NULL uniqueness and Person slots across all statuses, distinct committed backend connection races, failed real down migration retaining revoked Person ciphertext, and config rollback guard. Canonical encryption missing/invalid-key errors, in-place reconnect and resource-lane compatibility verified. docs/services/engine.md and system-config.md document storage decisions and later issue boundaries. No implementation environment blocker; existing missing license_manager configuration notice is nonfatal. No commits/push/PR/worktree creation. Keep issue in_progress for user review/uncommitted delivery per request; no later issue started.

Revision paused at user-requested integrity blocker gate. Documentation now records superseded architecture and reproducible PostgreSQL 18.4 results; precise descriptions updated for epic, storage and lifecycle, with downstream event/resolver/acceptance comments. No application/schema/migration/test replacement was made: duplicate columns remain in the prior uncommitted implementation pending a safe design. Temporary probe used independent backends 34494/34493/34492 and cleaned its disposable schema; it never touched application tables or migration metadata. Validation after documentation edits: mix format exit 0; focused MIX_ENV=test mix coveralls.json test/zaq/engine/connect test/zaq/engine/connect_test.exs test/zaq/engine/connect_token_edge_cases_test.exs test/zaq/engine/connect_encryption_error_test.exs exit 0 (129 tests + 1 property, 0 failures; includes existing migration/concurrency/encryption tests). Existing Connect coverage 95.3% (184/193), Credential 100% (20/20), Grant 100% (24/24). These are baseline FK implementation results, NOT evidence of polymorphic trigger correctness. mix q exit 0 (1181 source files, no issues); git diff --check exit 0. No commits/push/worktree or lifecycle implementation. Keep in_progress awaiting integrity-strategy decision and review.

Implemented final user-approved storage revision in current uncommitted files. Removed grant binding_type/dedicated person_id and Person FK; no triggers/guard rows. Canonical resource pair and provider/auth_kind/request_format/scopes/JWT issuer/key_id/subject derive server-side. Native resource/owner CHECKs and canonical partial unique org/person indexes across statuses retain legacy org/user resource behavior. Engine changeset checks literal current active Person on create/update, not caller authorization; stale aliases are not followed. Added independent-backend test proving the accepted deletion-between-check-and-insert orphan, plus inactive/deleted/alias and owner-update cases. secret_binding stays independent. Replaced transient trigger blocker with final storage decision; engine/system-config docs updated. Epic and all nine child descriptions preserve specifications and now carry final decision; .8 includes explicit bounded deterministic idempotent orphan-secret reconciliation implementation and safe telemetry tests, still unimplemented. Local DB: dev had not applied migration; branch test DB had superseded version with zero canonical rows/nondefault configs. Under ACCESS EXCLUSIVE transaction, guard rechecked absence of canonical data, removed only obsolete schema additions and version metadata, preserved all legacy rows, then revised migration applied through test runner. Validation: mix format exit 0; focused MIX_ENV=test mix coveralls.json Connect suites exit 0 (131 tests + 1 property, zero failures; real upgrade/down/up/retry, rollback protection, CHECK/FK/uniqueness, encryption and independent committed races). Changed application coverage Connect 95.5% (191/200), Credential 100% (20/20), Grant 100% (25/25). First mix q hit ExDNA internal 5-second task timeout; unchanged rerun passed (1181 files, 94 checks, no issues). git diff --check passed. Existing missing license_manager notice is nonfatal. No commits/push/worktree; remain in_progress pending independent review. Resolver/authenticated management/OAuth-refresh hardening/lifecycle reconciliation/Agent invalidation/UI remain later work; ID non-reuse and no synchronous erasure guarantee documented.
